Tuner T1 Pro is the ultimate instrument tuner, designed for precision tuning of a wide range of musical instruments. Whether you're tuning a guitar, violin, viola, bass, piano, cello, flute, or any other instrument, Tuner T1 ensures impeccable accuracy and ease of use. Ideal for both professional musicians and beginners, this chromatic tuner app is built to handle all common instruments with incredible precision, making it an essential tool for any musician. Now Available on Apple Watch! Tune directly from your wrist using the Apple Watch version, which features a fully functional chromatic tuner calibrated to standard A4 = 440 Hz. The watch app also includes a built-in tone generator, making quick tuning and pitch reference more accessible than ever. Key Features: • Extremely Accurate Tuning: Tune your instrument with an exceptional level of accuracy (within ±0.1 cents), ensuring perfect pitch every time. • Chromatic Tuner for All Instruments: Tuner T1 supports a broad range of instruments, including guitar, bass, violin, viola, cello, piano, flute, and more. Whether you're tuning strings, winds, or brass, Tuner T1 has you covered. • Tone Generator: Generate reference tones over a 3-octave range. Perfect for ear training or manual tuning when needed, the tone generator covers every note you need. • Adjustable A₄ Frequency: For those who need custom tunings, Tuner T1 allows you to change the A₄ reference frequency from the standard 440 Hz to other frequencies to suit any musical or regional style. • Customizable Detection Latency: Adapt the app to your specific needs by adjusting pitch detection latency. Lower latency settings allow for quicker pitch detection, ideal for fast-paced vocal practices. Higher latency settings help filter out unwanted noise and momentary sounds, providing stable tuning results—especially useful for precise instrument tuning. • Beautiful, Simple, & Easy-to-Use Interface: Tuner T1 is designed to be intuitive, allowing you to start tuning instantly without any complicated setup. It’s built with simplicity in mind while maintaining all the advanced features you need for professional-grade tuning. • Perfect for Professional and Amateur Musicians: Whether you're a professional musician performing on stage or an aspiring player honing your skills, Tuner T1 provides the accuracy and reliability you need to ensure your instrument is perfectly in tune every time. • Optimized for Low-Latency Performance: Our app delivers low-latency pitch detection, ensuring quick response times without sacrificing accuracy, making it a great tool for live performances or recording sessions. • Battery-Efficient: Tuner T1 is designed to minimize battery consumption, letting you use the app for extended tuning sessions without draining your device’s power. Why Choose Tuner T1? Tuner T1 stands out from other tuning apps because of its superior accuracy and low-latency pitch detection, specifically optimized for tuning a wide variety of common instruments. This app is built to cater to the needs of guitarists, violinists, pianists, and other musicians across different genres. With its sleek interface, customizable settings, and tone generation capabilities, Tuner T1 is not only powerful but incredibly user-friendly. Unlock Your Musical Potential With Tuner T1, you’re not just getting an ordinary tuner. You’re getting a tool that helps you achieve perfect pitch, fine-tune your ear, and enhance your performance. Whether you're practicing, recording, or performing live, Tuner T1 gives you the professional-level tuning accuracy you need. Download Tuner T1 Pro today and experience the next level of tuning accuracy for all your musical instruments!

entry.title: To the Moon
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：₺249,99 → ₺99,99 [₺79,99 ~ ₺249,99]）

All Price Information

Price：₺99,99

Application Description

A story-driven experience about two doctors traversing backwards through a dying man's memories to artificially fulfill his last wish. ABOUT THIS GAME Dr. Rosalene and Dr. Watts have peculiar jobs: They give people another chance to live, all the way from the very beginning... but only in their patients' heads. Due to the severity of the operation, the new life becomes the last thing the patients remember before drawing their last breath. Thus, the operation is only done to people on their deathbeds, to fulfill what they wish they had done with their lives, but didn’t. This particular story follows their attempt to fulfill the dream of an elderly man, Johnny. With each step back in time, a new fragment of Johnny's past is revealed. As the two doctors piece together the puzzled events that spanned a life time, they seek to find out just why the frail old man chose his dying wish to be what it is. And Johnny's last wish is, of course... to go to the moon. MORE DETAILS "To the Moon", a story-driven RPG with pixel graphics, was originally developed six years ago for PC by Canadian producer Kan Gao and Freebird Games, his indie game studio.Rights to develop and publish the remastered mobile version of "To the Moon" were acquired by X.D. Network Inc. The story of "To the Moon" unfolds before players, much like a movie. While the entire game has no battle system and can be completed in a few hours, the compelling story and moving original soundtrack resonated with players worldwide. On top of receiving overwhelmingly positive ratings, "To the Moon" received multiple awards from Gamespot, Metacritic, WIRED, and more, and was nominated for "I'm Not Crying, There's Something In My Eye" in the 2016 Steam Awards. entry.title: Solar Arc: Golden Hour Tracker
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：₺249,99 → ₺199,99 [Free ~ ₺299,99]）

All Price Information

Price：₺199,99

Application Description

Golden hour happens every single day. Most people miss it. SolarArc makes sure you don't. - Chasing golden hour for a photo? Know the exact minute it starts. - Planning a sunrise hike? See the best trail windows at a glance. - Wondering when the moon rises tonight? It's right there on your screen. SolarArc is a sun and moon tracker that feels like looking out the window. Every view shifts with the real sky - warm when the light is warm, dark when the sky is dark. THE GRADIENT LINE Your entire day, painted in one line. Dawn amber bleeds into midday blue, then sunset orange, then deep navy night. Golden hour glows. Blue hour cools. You can read the exact times, or just glance at the color and know where you are in the day. THE ARC The sun and moon traced across your sky in real time. Watch them rise, climb, and fall against a live gradient that shifts with the actual light outside your window. Drag your finger across the arc to scrub through the day - the sky, the times, and the numbers all move with you. View the sun alone, the moon alone, or both together. THE MOON Know when to look up. SolarArc renders tonight's moon with the correct phase shape on the arc. Plan around full moons. Catch a crescent at dusk. Know exactly how dark the sky will be. 52-WEEK FORECAST What will golden hour look like three Saturdays from now? How much daylight will you have on that hiking trip in April? Pick any date in the next year and see the full picture - sun, moon, and light - before you commit. FIVE WAYS TO USE THE SKY Photography - Golden hour and blue hour, down to the minute. Stop guessing when to shoot. Hiking - Best trail windows and how much daylight is left. Know when to turn around. Screens - A screen curfew that follows the sun. Wind down as the sky does. Gardening - When to water, when to protect, and how many sun hours your plants get today. Stargazing - When true darkness begins. The best window to see everything above you. FEATURES - Live gradient line and arc visualizations - Drag to scrub through any moment of the day - Sun view, moon view, or dual view - Golden hour and blue hour timing - Moonrise, moonset, phase, and illumination - 52-week forecast for any date - Five activity modes - Seven Home Screen widgets: sun and moon, line and arc, medium and large - Notifications for sunrise, sunset, and golden hour - Multi-location with automatic timezone handling - Available in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Korean, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Ukrainian, and Russian - Built on NOAA solar and Meeus lunar algorithms - Fully offline. No tracking. No account required. WHAT IS GOLDEN HOUR? Golden hour is the short window after sunrise and before sunset when the light turns soft, warm, and directional. Photographers chase it. Hikers love it. SolarArc tells you exactly when it happens, wherever you are. EVERYTHING INCLUDED All seven widgets, the 52-week forecast, unlimited saved places, all five modes, and golden hour, sunrise, and sunset alerts. One purchase. No subscription. No ads. No in-app purchases. Made by Spruzzo Labs - a creative lab. Questions or ideas? hello@spruzzolabs.com

entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：₺9,99 → ₺4,99 [₺2,99 ~ ₺9,99]）

All Price Information

Price：₺4,99

Application Description

A customer appears at your window and tells you what they want. You have two choices: say "Right away!" and open the tray, or tell them you're out and turn them away. But the game won't count your stock for you. You only see what you have left once the tray is open. You can step back, but the customer's patience keeps ticking. YOU BUILD THE TRAY Pick the item, set the portion, add the chili, add the salad, don't forget the drink. Get it right and you earn money and tips; get it wrong or leave something out and the receipt turns red, and the street talks. THE NIGHT ENDS, THE BILL COMES Revenue, costs, satisfaction. Restock from the wholesaler, choose your pricing, grow your stall. Tonight's satisfaction decides how many people come to your window tomorrow night. YOUR PRICES, YOUR CALL Cheap, normal, expensive. Go cheap and the street loves you but profits melt; go expensive and the till fills up but your name gets around. Stay off normal for too long and the bill arrives at the end of the day. GROW YOUR STALL Mussel counter, soup cauldron, grill, dessert case. Every piece of equipment grows your menu and comes with plenty of starter stock; each one is a goal worth saving up for. WHAT'S ON THE MENU Kokoreç in a sandwich, in half a loaf or on a plate, İzmir style, liver, sweetbread, köfte, sucuk. Tripe, lentil, head-and-trotter and tuzlama soups. Fried mussels, stuffed mussels. Sütlaç, cold baklava, carrot-slice baklava. Ayran, şalgam, gazoz, soda. WHO SHOWS UP The local shopkeeper, the taxi driver, the night-shift worker, the student, the tourist, the fussy auntie, three different football fans, a courier, a biker, a nurse, a police officer, a magician and more: 28 customers in all. Each has their own patience, budget and favorites. ACHIEVEMENTS AND STATS Four tiers in every category, 36 Game Center achievements in total. Climb the leaderboard with your career earnings. YOU CAN GO BUST There are two ways to lose: the street turns its back on you, or debt drowns you. Both show up a night in advance, because the reason for every loss is written on the receipt.
